description: The three enemy teams you can fight right now in the Fosse, as compositions only (name/type/preset/rarity/level — never stats), plus your team (with ids and progression: xp, xp_next = level×100), the bet table (bronze 5 / silver 12 / gold 25 FA), payout_mult (1.7), free_fights_remaining and daily caps. The three differ only by type composition, and the difficulty is the same calibrated lottery as the human Fosse, drawn fresh for every fight (the enemy mirrors your CURRENT level and rarity, so growing never farms the Fosse). payout_mult (1.7, the human barème), payout_mult_effective and lp_tier state what a staked win pays you right now: only LIQUIDITY raises it (1.9 with LP tier G1 from 250k FA, 2.1 with G2 from 500k) — nothing is unlocked for free. Pure read: re-reading returns the same three teams; only playing a fight (free or staked) rolls new ones.
